title: "biopharmaceutics"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Load library

```{r}
library(mrgsolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Zero order

```{r}
model <- '
$PARAM @annotated
k0 :   5.5 : rate constant (ng/ml/min)

$INIT @annotated
C      :   200 : Dosing compartment (ng/ml)

$ODE

dxdt_C = -k0;

' %>% 
  mcode("mymodel", .)
```


```{r}
out <- model %>% mrgsim(end=50,delta=0.1) %>% filter(C >= 0)
```

```{r}
out %>% ggplot(aes(x=time, y=C)) +
  geom_line()
```

## First order

```{r}
model <- '
$PARAM @annotated

C      :   200 : Dosing compartment (ng/ml)

$ODE
```


## One compartment model

```{r}
model <- '
$PARAM @annotated
kel :   0.04 : rate constant (mg/hr)
V0  :    0.3 : L/Kg
W   :     50 : Kg

$MAIN
double Vd = V0 * W;

$INIT @annotated
D      :   0 : Dosing compartment (mg)

$ODE

dxdt_D = -kel*D;

$TABLE
capture CP = D/Vd;
' %>% 
  mcode("mymodel", .)
```


```{r}
out <- model %>% ev(amt=100, ii=6, addl = 5) %>% mrgsim(end=50,delta=0.1) %>% as_tibble()
```

```{r}
out %>% ggplot(aes(x=time, y=CP)) +
  geom_line()
```

## Compartment Model Oral Administration

```{r}
model <- '
$PARAM @annotated
ka  : 0.0002 : rate constant (mg/hr)
kel :      4 : rate constant (mg/hr)
V0  :    0.3 : L/Kg
W   :     50 : Weight
F   : 0.000005 : S

$MAIN
double Vd = V0 * W;

$INIT @annotated
Xa     :   0 : intestinal compartment (mg)
D      :   0 : blood compartment (mg)

$ODE

dxdt_Xa = -ka*Xa;
dxdt_D = ka*F*Xa - kel*D;

$TABLE
capture CP = D/Vd;
' %>% 
  mcode("mymodel", .)
```


```{r}
out <- model %>% ev(amt=100) %>% mrgsim(end=500,delta=0.1) %>% as_tibble()
```

```{r}
out %>% ggplot(aes(x=time, y=CP)) +
  geom_line()
```
